notes.title: Development update on upcoming projects
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]It's been a while since the last announcement, so here's an update on how things are. In the last announcement, I mentioned that two VN projects were already in the works. Development on both is still ongoing. Below is a bit more information on each one.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Cold Verdict 3[/b][/p][p][/p][p]This will be the third and final part in the Cold Verdict series. (PS: The first Cold Verdict is currently on a discount at the time of this update, so might be a good time to get it if you haven't yet)[/p][p][/p][p]Cold Verdict 3 will be roughly the same length as the first two instalments and will be priced about the same. All of the story points and questions from the previous two games should be concluded and resolved in this one. At the moment I'm aiming to release it sometime near the end of the year.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783176/a264ad649174340d1c7f0db783638df2ae6f4391.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Post-apocalyptic sci-fi project that currently still has no definite name[/b][/p][p][/p][p]A lot more work has been done on this one over the last few months. As mentioned in the last update, this one will be a bigger game than Cold Verdict 3 and at least as long as Interim Crossroads. This story will involve relationship building, choices with consequences, character stats to keep track of, multiple endings, as well as a choice to play as either a male or a female main character. The choice to play as male or female is not just cosmetic here. The intention is to provide a somewhat different experience, where characters will treat you differently depending on whether you're male or female. This means some dialogues will differ, some scenes, romance options, and even some of the endings. [/p][p][/p][p]There's no definite title for this project yet, but this will come later on in development. The release date for this one will most likely be in early 2026, so it should hopefully not be a long time after Cold Verdict 3 release when this one will also be out. Also keep a look out for more development updates in the coming months.[/p][p][/p][p]For now, I hope you enjoy some screenshots below from this project.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783176/4b05c0bffc1e6fdad6a930cc3f35be9c193aa387.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Projects for 2025
notes.content:
Hi all!

I would like to share some information on the new projects that are planned for this year and on which the development is already ongoing. There are two projects planned for this year (depending on the development time, one might be pushed back onto early 2026, but that remains to be seen).

The first one, the shorter project, is as was mentioned before, the final 3rd part to Cold Verdict series which will serve as a conclusion to the story. Another familiar face from the first game will now return in this one...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783176/4bcff9b719529106888b1d32bf57596e2fde68e5.jpg[/img]

The second project, which will be longer and bigger, is going to be set in a post-apocalyptic near future world, mainly taking place inside an underground sanctuary. We'll play the role of a volunteer for a gene therapy experiment to make humans able to survive in the new world. Similarly to Interim Crossroads, this VN will have some character stats to keep track of, which will unlock some new options during the in-game choices. Another major element in the story-telling here is that we'll get a choice of our main character being male or female at the start, and this will have an effect on how others will treat you, as well as the available romance options, and even some endings will be possible only with either male or female.
For now there's no title for this project, but once there is a decision on that, I'll mention it in one of the updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783176/a1e9d79695945dd0541c9e8da11a1f8e6067756a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783176/17584d31eee61e0f586f9018f314cadaf423ae48.jpg[/img]

Thank you for the support! Let's hope this year will prove to be a positive year on all fronts!

notes.title: Explicit Setting is now Available!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Thanks for playing the game and giving feedback over the last few months.

Due to a somewhat popular demand, I decided to add an Explicit setting to the game that can be chosen from the very start. With the Explicit setting selected, more images will be seen during the erotic scenes, showing even more of our beautiful Gwen than before. 

I've also added one new achievement - to complete the game in Explicit mode whilst having experienced all of the major erotic scenes.

Thanks once again for all your support!

notes.title: Nominate "Holiday with Gwen" for Outstanding Visual Style
notes.content:
Hi all and Happy Steam Sale!

I hope those of you who have tried the game already have enjoyed it thoroughly. Since the Steam awards are happening right now, perhaps "Holiday with Gwen" will get lucky enough to be nominated by a person or two. That will be a huge honour if you feel "Holiday with Gwen" deserves a nomination, for whichever category you choose. I thought I'd suggest we could go for the "Outstanding Visual Style". We might not have the super HD graphics or an art style that puts Picasso to shame, but we do have Gwen, and she is gorgeous. So if you feel the wonderful Gwen or the beautiful holiday resort we get to visit in "Holiday with Gwen" are worthy of a nomination, please feel free to vote for it.

All the best!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783176/465619892b5c5eb7eac6c8cbcd65ed0217636c31.png[/img]

notes.title: Achievement fix
notes.content:

Thank you for the support so far and please enjoy the game!
